item.title: Islamic foundation brings dates to inmates during Ramadan
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — After fasting from sunrise to sunset, the first bite that many Muslims take during Ramadan is traditionally a Medjool date. It’s sweet, nourishing and specific to the Islamic religion. item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — The Lincoln Transportation and Utilities Department announced the partial closure of three Lincoln streets. item.title: ‘He had a huge heart’: Dozens honor Sgt. Noah Tietjens at candlelight vigil
item.description: BELLEVUE, Neb. (KLKN) — The community of Bellevue celebrated a fallen U.S. soldier on Thursday night, honoring the life of Sgt. First Class Noah Tietjens. Tietjens, a native of Bellevue, is one of six U.S. Army soldiers that was killed by a drone strike in Kuwait while supporting Operation Epic Fury.
